type CallbackResults<T> = T extends { a: (cb: () => infer U) => void; b: (cb: () => infer U) => void } ? U : never;
const incompatible: CallbackResults<{ a: (cb: () => string) => void; b: (cb: () => number) => void }> = 'wrong';
type NestedParameters<T> = T extends {
  a: (cb: (value: infer U) => void) => void;
  b: (cb: (value: infer U) => void) => void;
} ? U : never;
const outsideUnion: NestedParameters<{
  a: (cb: (value: string) => void) => void;
  b: (cb: (value: number) => void) => void;
}> = true;
